title: ever ZERENA|Ruffle Sleeve A-Line Formal Evening Dress with Slit
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening look with our Tie-Front Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Evening Dress! This enchanting piece features delicate ruffle sleeves and a chic tie-front detail, creating a flattering silhouette that flows beautifully. Perfect for weddings, cocktail parties, or any special occasion, this dress will make you the center of attention!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
